title: Writing pass after your send-back
body: You asked for the AI writing tics out of this and the other blueprints. A fresh register editor read the whole file against the developer-docs register and the house tells, and its 41 rewrites are applied. Every changed line was then fact-checked against its old wording, so no claim moved.
"own" is gone everywhere. The register already bans the intensifier "own"; Survey backlog #1 adds a deterministic check so it is caught in all house writing.

title: The figure keeps the fixture as is (your call)
body: You chose to keep `fixtureNavLayout` unchanged. Media shows its default label, Library, and the settings entry carries the relabel example (Site settings).

title: This row covers navFilter as well as attention
body: The plan covered only a throwing `attention` function. The code shows the shell load runs `navFilter` the same way, with no catch (`content-routes-shell.ts:198`), so a throwing filter also fails every admin page. The row names both functions.

title: The link goes to createCairnAdmin, not ContentRoutesConfig
body: The plan linked `#contentroutesconfig`, but `docs/reference/sveltekit.md` has no heading for `ContentRoutesConfig`. The link points at `createCairnAdmin`, which forwards `navFilter` unchanged.

title: When the layout is checked
was: The tree validates once at runtime composition and fails the build.
now: The tree is checked when `createCairnAdmin` or `createContentRoutes` builds the admin. An adapter with no `navLayout` skips the check.
body: The shared facts `f:ld6xam` and `f:bc27j9` said a bad layout fails the build. `composeRuntime` passes `navLayout` through unchecked, and nothing fails at build time. Both facts are corrected, and every line on this page that cites them says server start.

title: Fact check fix: the menu editor is the nav screen
was: The public site's menu and the menu editor `editor.nav` turns on, which share the word nav with the `nav` screen.
now: Build the public routes covers the public site's menu and the menu editor that `editor.nav` turns on as the `nav` screen at `/admin/nav`.
body: The old line read as if the menu editor and the `nav` screen were two things. They are one screen.

title: Fact check fix: the nav screen's default label
was: A concept's own label, or Library, Tags, Settings, Editors, and Help for the fixed screens.
now: Splits the defaults into sentences and adds that `nav` takes the label the adapter's `editor.nav` declares.
body: The line left out `nav`, whose default label comes from the adapter.

title: Module paths are the scaffold's only
body: The plan also gave the paths from the Add cairn to a SvelteKit app tutorial. Their only source is that page, so under your D1 ruling the page names both modules by what they do and gives the scaffold's paths alone.
